COURSE_OBJECTIVE: Help every staff member protect personal data and official information, and recognise and report common cyber threats.
COURSE_DESCRIPTION: An awareness course on the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, safe handling of personal and official data, phishing and social engineering, passwords and incident reporting.

general_quiz.QUIZ_UPLOAD_INSTRUCTION: Answer all questions. Select one option per question and submit before the timer runs out.
general_quiz.QUIZ_DESCRIPTION: Final assessment for Data Protection & Cybersecurity Awareness.

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: What is Nigeria's primary data protection law?
Which body regulates data protection in Nigeria?
Which of these is personal data?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: A staff member's phone number and home address
QUIZ_OPTIONS: The name of a public holiday
A staff member's phone number and home address

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: You get an email from 'IT Support' asking you to confirm your password through a link. What should you do?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Don't click, and report it to the IT/security team
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Click the link and confirm quickly
Don't click, and report it to the IT/security team

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: Which is a common sign of a phishing email?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Urgent tone and a sender address that doesn't match the organisation
QUIZ_OPTIONS: An email sent during work hours
A message from your known supervisor's verified address
Urgent tone and a sender address that doesn't match the organisation

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: What is the best practice for passwords?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Use a long, unique passphrase for each account and enable multi-factor authentication
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Use a long, unique passphrase for each account and enable multi-factor authentication
Write it on a sticky note on your monitor
Share it with a trusted colleague

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: You need to step away from your computer. What should you do?
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Nothing, it's fine for a few minutes
Leave it open for a colleague

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: How should official documents be shared?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Through approved official channels and systems
QUIZ_OPTIONS: On unencrypted USB drives left on desks
Through approved official channels and systems

questions.QUIZ_QUESTION: You suspect a data breach. What is the right first step?
questions.QUIZ_ANSWER: Report it immediately to the designated officer or IT security
QUIZ_OPTIONS: Report it immediately to the designated officer or IT security
Wait to see if it happens again

course_lessons.TITLE: Personal Data & the Nigeria Data Protection Act
course_lessons.DESCRIPTION: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets out how personal data must be collected, processed, stored and shared, and established the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC). This lesson explains what counts as personal data and the principles of lawful, fair and secure processing.
